expectations.text: Exposes rotation as a single atomic roll operation that creates the new key and schedules the old key's expiry in one call

expectations.text: Warns against splitting rotation into two manual steps where the expiry half gets forgotten

expectations.text: Reserves zero-grace immediate revocation for compromise or offboarding, never routine rotation
